units.source_text: 山中的朱雀院为了二公主青春守寡，受人讪笑，心中闷闷不乐。

en.t: The Suzaku Emperor in the mountains was gloomy and unhappy because the Second Princess had been widowed in her youth and was mocked by others.

units.source_text: 而三公主又出家为尼，脱离尘世，使他觉得诸事都不称心。

en.t: And because the Third Princess had also taken religious vows as a nun and left the world behind, he felt that nothing was going as he wished.

units.source_text: 然而身已为僧，自应抛却一切世虑，逆来顺受。

en.t: Yet since he himself had already become a monk, he ought to cast aside all worldly concerns and accept whatever came.

units.source_text: 他在做功课的时候，推想三公主也正和他同样地勤修佛道，

en.t: When he performed his devotions, he imagined that the Third Princess too was diligently practicing the Buddhist path just as he was,

units.source_text: 故自三公主出家之后，他常常写信给她，小小的事情也都谈到。

en.t: so after the Third Princess took religious vows, he often wrote to her and spoke of even the smallest matters.
